questions.prompt: How should we resolve the degenerate attribute lattice in Issue #14?
questions.description: The current 10 attributes (3 drivers, 4 targets, 3 states) are mutually exclusive categoricals, bounding concepts to 48 combinations without internal implications. We can either enrich attributes now with co-occurring flags or retain the taxonomy while implementing endpoints.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Keep current 10 attributes for now as a structured step taxonomy/contingency matrix, focusing this remediation on fixing #8–#13 cleanly.

options.label: (Recommended) Keep current 10 attributes for now as a structured step taxonomy/contingency matrix, focusing this remediation on fixing #8–#13 cleanly
Expand step_matrix schema and FCA_ATTRIBUTES now to include co-occurring step attributes (e.g. multi-valued targets, tool usage flags, course corrections)
Keep the 10 core attributes, but add 2–3 binary flags (e.g., ran_tests, touched_config) that can co-occur

questions.prompt: How should the schema migration (v15 session_steps table) handle existing session step data?
questions.description: There are currently ~63 sessions with step matrices stored in insights.metadata. When migrating to session_steps, should existing JSON matrices be parsed and backfilled?
questions.recommendedAnswer: Add migration v15 to create session_steps AND parse existing insights.metadata JSON to populate session_steps rows automatically.

options.label: (Recommended) Add migration v15 to create session_steps AND parse existing insights.metadata JSON to populate session_steps rows automatically
Only create the table in v15; populate session_steps purely for new/re-analyzed sessions

questions.prompt: How should FCA objects (rows) be keyed to ensure uniqueness across single and pooled contexts?
questions.description: Issue #11 notes that step descriptions can duplicate within or across sessions, silently collapsing distinct steps into one object in formal contexts.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Format as `${turn_ref} [step ${idx}]` (for single session) and `${session_id}:${turn_ref}#${idx}` (for pooled context), keeping human label as an attribute/metadata field.

options.label: (Recommended) Format as `${turn_ref} [step ${idx}]` (for single session) and `${session_id}:${turn_ref}#${idx}` (for pooled context), keeping human label as an attribute/metadata field
Format as `${turn_ref} - ${label}` (falling back to adding index if duplicate)

questions.prompt: What mechanism should be provided for re-analyzing v3.0.0 sessions under v3.1.0?
questions.description: Issue #8 requires identifying and queueing v3.0.0 sessions for re-analysis so decision attribution and step matrix data are refreshed.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Document the exact SQL filter query in docs/migrations AND add a convenience CLI command or flag to queue v3.0.0 sessions.

options.label: (Recommended) Document the exact SQL filter query in docs/migrations AND add a convenience CLI command or flag to queue v3.0.0 sessions
Provide only the documented SQL query and API filter without adding a CLI backfill command
